notes.subject: rehe
notes.rationale: avañeʼẽ requires relational 'rehe' on the object; Hebrew has none

notes.subject: יתאדם
notes.rationale: from אדם 'red/flush': 'turns red' (KJV) vs 'sparkles' (ASV/BSB); kept the literal blood-red flush

notes.subject: בכיס
notes.rationale: rare word: 'cup' here vs 'money-bag' elsewhere; rendered as generic ryru (container)

notes.subject: במישרים
notes.rationale: 'in uprightness/straightness': KJV 'moveth itself aright' vs 'goes down smoothly' (ASV/JPS); kept literal 'walks in the even/straight'

notes.subject: to the reader
notes.rationale: second-person deprecative imperative warning against wine

translation: Ani erecha ⟨rehe⟩ kaguy arakaʼe oky pytã hague, arakaʼe omeʼẽ ⟨rehe⟩ hesa ryru ryepýpe, ha oguata ojoja hápe.
